g.text: Shared distances only: full supports clear all three initial 10%-contrast regions. Dotted heading lines mark actual cue targets.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Rate segments span their actual saved intervals, not instantaneous native-RHS values. Weak R < 0.1 creates gaps; no phase is unwrapped across them.

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Time is linear 0–0.1, logarithmic thereafter. Rate y axes are linear near zero and logarithmic in magnitude beyond ±0.001; scales are not cross-model clocks.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: A global angular rate includes projection and cancellation; it is not local-peak travel. Near-antipodal targets require the accompanying R and native profiles.
